messages:
Maya: heads-up drafting an updated internal incident comms styleguide for oncalls and comms folks. want it short, copy-paste ready, and clear on who owns customer contact vs internal coordination. dropping a draft below — pls review for tone & gaps. :memo:
Ravi: nice! can you include guidance for regional incidents (APAC/EU) and timezone-aware cadences? we've had confusion on when to bump cadence for night shifts.
Nora: also +1 for legal/CS checkpoint for anything that might trigger SLA review. add a field for 'customer-impact severity' so CS can triage outreach.
Maya: good points. adding timezone line and a small SLA flag. here's the draft snippet. meant to be pasteable into threads and bot templates.
Maya: ```
INTERNAL INCIDENT COMMS TEMPLATE (copyable)
- Severity: {{SEV}}  # SEV1/SEV2/SEV3
- TL;DR (one line): {{TLDR}}
- Impact window: {{START_TS}} -> {{EST_END_TS | TBD}} (timezone: {{TZ}})
- Services / endpoints: {{SERVICES}}
- Region(s): {{REGIONS}}
- Customer impact severity: {{CUSTOMER_IMPACT}} (none/minor/major/critical)

Summary: 1 sentence in plain english describing what started and who noticed it.
Current status: what we are doing right now. list active actions with owners: e.g., "restarted pool (Ravi), rolling rollback (Nora)."
Mitigations (owner | ETA):
- Immediate: {{ACTION}}  (owner) 
- Short term: {{ACTION}}  (owner) 
- Monitoring-only: {{ACTION}}  (owner)

Watchpoints: metrics to watch (p95, error rate, queue depth, token throughput). include thresholds that would trigger escalation.
Escalation rule: if primary metric not improved by {{ESCALATION_PCT}}% within {{ESCALATION_WINDOW}} -> escalate to SRE lead and product oncall.
Customer-facing blurb (50-140 chars): {{CUSTOMER_BLURB}}
Post to status page? {{STATUS_POST_DECISION}} (see decision matrix below)
CS outreach owner: {{CS_OWNER}} (contact: {{CS_CONTACT}})
Legal review required: {{YES/NO}} (if yes, tag legal slack: #legal-incidents)
Next update ETA: {{CADENCE}}
Handoff note (when transferring oncall): include what worked, what failed, outstanding risk, next steps, and who to page if things regress.
Post-incident follow-ups: postmortem owner: {{PM_OWNER}}, customer comms owner: {{COMM_OWNER}}
```
Maya: decision matrix I propose to include below the snippet so responders have explicit thresholds.
Maya: ```
DECISION MATRIX (defaults)
- Post to public status page: if >= {{THRESH_PUBLIC_CUSTOMERS}} customers affected OR any auth/payment failures OR region-wide outage.
- Trigger CS outreach: if named customers or high-usage tenants are affected OR customer-impact severity = major/critical.
- Legal review: if financial impact OR data integrity concerns OR regulatory region (EU/UK) involved.
- Increase update cadence to 15m if incident overlaps business hours for affected customers' regions; otherwise 30m.
```
Ravi: I like the timezone-aware cadence. can we make CADENCE auto-suggest based on REGIONS? e.g., if REGIONS includes APAC and it's APAC daytime, cadence = 15m. might be something IncidentBot can compute.
Nora: editorial: for customer-facing blurb, prefer contractions and empathetic phrasing. examples to include in the docs: 
- Short: "We're investigating increased error rates affecting some API requests. We're working on a fix and will update every 30 minutes."
- With workaround: "We're investigating errors affecting some requests. As a workaround, reduce batch size or retry after 20s. Updates every 30 minutes."
Sam: ops question: do we want a separate small blurb for high-compliance customers that references our private deployment option or dedicated contact? maybe: "If you see production impact and you're a dedicated instance customer, contact <support@redwood> for priority assistance."
Maya: added a PRIO_CONTACT placeholder and a short guidance to avoid naming specific SLAs in public blurbs. internal-only note can reference SLA clause.
IncidentBot: AUTO: Pager (SEV2)  /v1/embeddings elevated 5xx rate. Pager routed to oncall: Sam.
Sam: ack. re: templates, one operational addition: include a small checklist for 'what to paste into status post' vs 'what to include in email to CS' so folks don't accidentally leak internal links in public posts.
Maya: good catch. adding a "status post safe fields" line to the template (only include CUSTOMER_BLURB and TL;DR).
Ravi: also propose adding a short 'translation note' for global customers: if incident impacts non-English speaking regions, add a translated blurb or CS-owner to help with localized comms.
Nora: final editorial: add 'avoid percentages unless verified' to the customer blurb guidance. we've had customers upset by inaccurate numbers.
Maya: updated. putting final consolidated snippet below with quick-copy blocks for bot and handoff.
Maya: ```
QUICK COPY (Bot-friendly)
/incident template internal 
(replaces placeholders where possible)

---
INTERNAL: {{TLDR}}
Severity: {{SEV}} | Regions: {{REGIONS}} | Services: {{SERVICES}}
Customer impact: {{CUSTOMER_IMPACT}} | CS owner: {{CS_OWNER}}
Status: {{CURRENT_STATUS}}
Mitigations: {{MITIGATION_SUMMARY}}
Next update: {{CADENCE}} | Runbook: {{RUNBOOK_URL}}
---

STATUS-PAGE SAFE (public):
{{CUSTOMER_BLURB}} (do not include internal links or metrics)
```
Sam: this is solid. one extra ask: include a line in the template for 'who will own the customer update' so we don't have two people sending different messages. maybe a field: CUSTOMER_COMMS_OWNER.
Maya: added CUSTOMER_COMMS_OWNER and CS_CONTACT. also added a reminder to tag legal if YES for Legal review.
IncidentBot: AUTO: Template added to infra/incidents/templates.md (branch: comms-style/2112345678)  quick command `/incident template internal` now supports REGION-based CADENCE suggestions in draft.
Ravi: i'll prototype the bot logic for timezone cadence. putting a small PR after this.
Nora: i'll take tone pass and add the short blurb variants for legal/CS review.
Sam: i'll update the oncall runbook to reference the new template and add the handoff checklist to the rotation doc.
Maya: thanks all. i'll open the PR and tag reviewers: Nora (tone), Ravi (bot), Sam (runbooks). target merge today if possible. closing thread after PR posted. :rocket:
